test_matrix.evidence: Verifies signed cordon request event kind, d tag, worker tag, command tag, agent tag, content reason/operator metadata/idempotency, and receipt correlation kinds.
Verifies labels update request carries labels and receives a generated idempotency d tag when caller omits one.
Verifies command publication treats zero accepted relays as failure rather than assuming publish success.
Verifies handler mutates scheduling state to cordoned, records scheduling note, emits status/result events, and publishes worker state read model.
Verifies labels update persists sanitized labels and worker state read model includes label tags.
Verifies missing idempotency key produces validation result and does not transition worker to draining.
Verifies worker tag/content mismatch is rejected before either worker is mutated.
Verifies disabled workers cannot be moved back to active through maintenance exit or other lifecycle commands before enable support exists.
Verifies all worker command kinds are in the default controlplane request subscription filter.
Verifies app package still compiles with production reactor worker-repository wiring.
Verifies repository package still compiles with targeted worker scheduling-state and labels update methods used by controlplane handlers.
